name: CROSS_SECTIONAL_RELATIVE_STRENGTH_RESEARCH

closed_or_failed: metal compression-break not forward-eligible under frozen DD gate
stage0003 single-asset structural families: 0 robust leads

rationale: Test a structurally different family: simultaneous relative ranking across assets rather than single-asset time-series rules.

universe_rule.coverage_filter: include only symbols with first timestamp <= 2019-01-15 and last timestamp >= 2026-08-01
universe_rule.late_history_symbols_excluded_by_rule: e.g. UK100 if coverage starts after cutoff

event_rules.signal: rank percentage return over lookback among universe members at same H1 timestamp
event_rules.momentum: long top tail, short bottom tail
event_rules.reversal: long bottom tail, short top tail
event_rules.entry: next available H1 bar open per selected symbol
event_rules.no_overlap: next portfolio signal only after all legs of prior portfolio have exited
event_rules.cost: one observed entry spread per leg; stress x2 and x3
event_rules.normalization: each leg P/L divided by ATR14 at signal; portfolio equal-weight legs

neighbor_definition: same universe/style; exactly one of lookback/hold/tail moves to adjacent predefined grid value; neighbor good if mean>0, stress2>0, trim1>0
next_if_robust_lead: freeze best predeclared cross-sectional rule and perform execution/reproduction validation only
next_if_no_lead: continue to another structurally distinct family; do not micro-tune failed grids
